title: "A-2 camera being installed in U-2" – ground crew at camera bay (Chapter 2, p. 77)
description: Black-and-white photograph of ground crew working on a U-2 parked on a ramp, with one technician standing atop the fuselage and others beneath the open equipment bay where the camera is being fitted. Captioned "A-2 camera being installed in U-2." The text covers the Air Force's Project DRAGON LADY purchase of U-2s and April 1956 operational readiness overflights of the United States.
